notes.title: LIVE on KICKSTARTER
notes.content:
Hey there Steam community. Big news! Our Kickstarter is now live. You can check it out by following the link below:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/essenceoftime/essence-of-time]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/essenceoftime/essence-of-time[/url]

We've designed some pretty cool rewards if I do say so myself. You can get your name in the credits. You can get the art book. You can even get yourself into the game itself!

We've also got a solid 2-4 hour demo. It sets up quite a lot of intrigue and yet it works as a self-contained episode in its own right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39574238/a52f1674658417f209706f7350eea8cf67d05d3c.png[/img]

Thank you for following along on our journey bringing this project to life.
Want to chat? Swing by our discord: [url=https://discord.gg/jbukx6CuGs]https://discord.gg/jbukx6CuGs[/url]
